headline: BAL @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.04 at BOS 3.93, with a projected total of 7.97. Pitching context: Connelly Early has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jarren Duran, Willson Contreras, Ceddanne Rafaela, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Weston Wilson, Tyler O'Neill because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
